decisions.statement: The index is built by running this file rather than by calling a command.
The checkout the index is built for is the first word on the command line.
A call naming no checkout builds the index for the checkout this file sits in.
No root named in the environment moves the build off that checkout.
The whole index is built rather than the part git does not carry.
A build that could not finish says why in one line and leaves a code that is not zero.
Nothing of the index itself is printed.

definition: the index built for a checkout by running one file
